remarks: Beautifully updated Saltbox Colonial set on a full acre in North Stamford with easy access to the Merritt Parkway and public transportation. This inviting home offers 4 bedrooms, including a rare first-floor primary suite, and 3.5 updated bathrooms throughout. Sun-filled living spaces showcase a functional layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The flat, lush front and side yard is enhanced by mature landscaping, while the private backyard features a stunning Ipe deck, perfect for relaxing or hosting outdoors. The finished lower level includes a dedicated home theater with surround sound and abundant storage. Additional highlights include a whole-house dehumidifier and generator, natural gas utilities, and a detached two-car garage equipped with an EV charging station. A special opportunity combining land, updates, and convenience in a desirable North Stamford setting.
